verified_key_information_units.information: Fleet management involved the sale of three vessels (passenger vessel Star I in April, cargo vessels Regal Star in August and Sailor in October) and reduction of lay-up vessels from four to zero by Q3 2025; three vessels (Romantika, Galaxy I, Silja Europa) remained chartered out at year-end.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The summary begins with overall performance, then details revenue breakdowns, profitability metrics, operational indicators, capital expenditures, liquidity, and shareholder returns. Each section builds on the previous one with consistent terminology and directional trends (e.g., declines in revenue and profit). There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. While some numerical relationships (e.g., segment vs. consolidated revenue) are not explicitly reconciled, the candidate does not claim they are exhaustive additive components, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity.
